title: festuca rubra subsp. kashmiriana
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. kashmiriana, commonly known as Kashmir Red Fescue, is a subspecies of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate various health conditions such as arthritis and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Kashmir Red Fescue include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
